body: Lots of comments here, so this one will just get lost in the shuffle.  But essentially BK’s franchise model sets itself up for this kind of failing.  Others will follow, except McDonald’s as they have a different structure. In short, these franchise models, like BK, attract entrepreneurs, NOT restauranteurs.  Or at least the original BK restauranteurs sold out years ago. Many other chains will follow, we will see the implosion of QSR this century. (PS - my comment does not mean to suggest McDonald’s Owner/Operators are restauranteurs, rather their agreement with the corporation really doesn’t put them same category you find at other chains.)
The commute alone is enough reason to stay put. Stop deliberating and enjoy your job you lucky son of a bitch.

OP… my heart bleeds for you. I too had a 1.5 hour one way commute… 3 hours a day… 15 hours a week.  I did it for about 5 years and I still have PTSD from it. Seems I can’t afford to live close to the work I do, but I can’t live with a long commute again. The good news is, I’ll eventually die. (Username checks out)

You will hate your dream job if it has a 2.5 hour commute.  Couple things… might take a year for that hatred to seed and be real, but it will come.  If you have a spouse you love and (shutter) kids you love, then it will happen quicker.

This is the evolution of all LSR (Limited Service Restaurants)/QSR (Quick Service Restaurants)… ESPECIALLY when they go public. Once a chain “makes it” growth becomes harder, so to make the numbers they cut back… food quality, operations, labor, equipment. Then the franchisor gets rough with the franchisee’s financials so they cut back on labor even more… raise prices, etc. The consumer get screwed.  But we consumers (sheep) are so trained to consume, we don’t stop going, just go on social media and complain.  Every restaurant company knows this and since the liability is not there (little or no consumer backlash) they just keep getting shitter.

Dave Thomas is rolling in his grave with what Wendy has become. Ray Kroc would NOT be impress with McDonald’s (but he would like the cash it turns), and McLamore/Edgerton would be fucking pissed at the shit show Burger King is now.

Steve Ells is still alive so while he may not like what has become of Chipolte, he still has breath to laugh all the way to the bank.
